$comment: Schema for a rubric — the set of acceptance criteria for one persona against one diff.

diffRef.$comment: Git range or commit SHA this rubric was generated for.

id.$comment: Short slug for referencing in evidence and fix proposals.

statement.$comment: The criterion itself. Format: [persona] [action] → [observable outcome]. Must be falsifiable from static code reading.
statement.example: returning-mobile-user's expired token → refresh happens transparently; user is not redirected to /login

rationale.$comment: One sentence: why this criterion matters for this persona and this diff.
rationale.example: The diff changes session.ts refresh logic; a regression here silently logs out returning users.

changedFiles.$comment: Which changed files are most relevant to evaluating this criterion.

criteria.statement: returning-mobile-user's expired token → refresh call succeeds silently; no /login redirect
criteria.rationale: Core session.ts change; a regression here logs out returning users without warning.

criteria.statement: concurrent refresh calls → only one refresh executes; subsequent calls wait and reuse the result
criteria.rationale: Diff adds a mutex; without it, parallel requests trigger multiple refresh attempts and may revoke each other.

criteria.statement: refresh token expired → user is redirected to /login with a clear message, not a silent blank page
criteria.rationale: Ensures graceful degradation when refresh is impossible.
